tables.caption_tex: The verified cohort's post hoc contrasts on all three endpoints. C1/C2 are defined in Section\nonbreakingspace \ref {sec:fresh}; S1 is fresh validation-best minus the defaults rule, and S2 is validation-best among defaults minus reused validation-best. On each endpoint C1/C2 and the secondary contrasts retain separate Holm families. Rejections do not confer confirmatory status (Appendix\nonbreakingspace \ref {sec:inference}). Holm-adjusted $p$-values of the bootstrap and paired $t$-tests over tasks, unadjusted Wilcoxon $p$, and win/tie/loss counts (a win: the left rule has the lower regret). Error regret: the chosen candidate's test log loss minus the unit's best, over the median candidate's minus the best; log loss: the chosen candidate's test log loss minus the unit's best.
